title: Birthday Spend Burn Rate by Month
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:spend
| search amount=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as spend count as purchases by _time month
| sort - _time
description: Tracks birthday spending over time and breaks it out by month.
value: Monthly burn rate shows whether birthday generosity is smooth or bunching into financially awkward stretches.
implementation: Send birthday spending events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1mon granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of birthday spending by month.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how birthday spending changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
